sections.heading: List item
paragraphs: A list item is a single row in a list, menu or file browser that shows a headline and, depending on its type, an icon, supporting text, metadata or a selection control.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: List items are the rows that make up a list. Each type has a fixed set of content, so choose the type that matches what the row represents. Any type can also hold a Checkbox or Radio at its start or end, for multi-select or single-select lists.

sections.heading: Types
paragraphs: Leading icon, headline, supporting text and metadata.
Leading icon, headline and supporting text.

sections.heading: When to use
paragraphs: •   To show a vertical set of related items — Default.
•   To list actions or destinations in a menu — Menu.
•   To show files with an icon, details and metadata — File.
•   To show a setting with a short description — Setting.
•   To let users pick one or several items — add a Radio or Checkbox as a leading or trailing control.

sections.heading: Anatomy
paragraphs: •   ① Container — the row's visual container; carries state colors, padding and radius.
•   ② Leading icon — File and Setting types only.
•   ③ Headline — required title text, on every type.
•   ④ Supporting text — File and Setting types only.
•   ⑤ Metadata — trailing text such as a count or file size; File type only.
Not shown: leading-control / trailing-control (a real Checkbox or Radio instance, toggled with has-leading-control / has-trailing-control) and the Menu type's trailing chevron.

sections.heading: Sizes
paragraphs: Each size has its own minimum height, padding, gap, icon size and type size.

sections.heading: Alignment
paragraphs: The control sits before the content — e.g. multi-select lists.
The control sits after the content — e.g. settings lists.
Use either a leading icon or a leading control in a row.
Don't combine a leading control with the leading icon — they are mutually exclusive.

sections.heading: Placement
paragraphs: List items are stacked in a List container (vertical, no fill, stretches to its parent's width). The List component isn't built yet.

sections.heading: Main elements
paragraphs: •   Required on every type and always visible.
•   Secondary detail under the headline — File and Setting types.
•   Short trailing text such as a timestamp, size or count — File type.

sections.heading: Overflow content
paragraphs: The skill defines a truncate-text option: on, the headline and supporting text end in an ellipsis and a tooltip shows the full text in code; off, text wraps. It isn't exposed as a Figma property yet.

sections.heading: States
paragraphs: Items start unselected (Default). Selected is a persistent highlight for chosen items; Activated is a persistent indicator for the current navigation location. Both are token swaps on the container.
•   Focused — keyboard focus, shown with a 2px border (color/border/focused).
•   Dragged — the item is being moved; 2px border (color/border/dragged).
•   Skeleton — placeholder shapes while content loads.
See the Style tab for how each state looks.

sections.heading: Interactions
paragraphs: Hovering and pressing a row show the Hover and Pressed states. A leading or trailing control is a real Checkbox or Radio and keeps its own interaction.
Move between items at the same level
Full keyboard details are on the Accessibility tab.

sections.heading: Nesting
paragraphs: The skill defines up to four nesting levels, indented with space/indent/level-{n}, and a chevron that rotates 90° when a parent is expanded. Nesting isn't built as a property yet.

sections.heading: Related
paragraphs: These components are used inside list items as selection controls.
•   Checkbox — CheckboxControl is the atomic check box used as a leading or trailing control in multi-select lists.
•   Radio — RadioControl is the atomic radio circle used as a control in single-select lists.

sections.heading: Color
paragraphs: Each state aliases its own component/list-item token. Swatches are bound to the live tokens.
Icon color follows the same pattern: color/icon/{state}. All tokens live in the component.list-item collection.

sections.heading: Typography
paragraphs: Text is not bound to typography tokens yet (raw values).

sections.heading: Variants & states
paragraphs: 108 variants: Type (4) × State (9) × Size (3). The grid shows State × Type at Size=Md.

sections.heading: Icons
paragraphs: The leading icon is 16 / 20 / 24px for Sm / Md / Lg, bound to icon/size/{sm|md|lg}. The Menu type has a fixed trailing chevron. Leading and trailing controls are 20px Checkbox instances by default, swappable to Radio.

sections.heading: List item
paragraphs: A list item is a single row in a list, menu or file browser that shows a headline and, depending on its type, an icon, supporting text, metadata or a selection control.

sections.heading: What the design system provides
paragraphs: •   A Focused state on every type, with a 2px border bound to color/border/focused.
•   Disabled, Selected, Activated, Dragged and Skeleton states, each a token swap on the container.
•   Selection controls are real Checkbox / Radio instances, so they inherit those components' accessibility.
•   Minimum heights of 32, 40 and 48px — above the 24×24px target-size minimum (WCAG 2.5.8).

sections.heading: Development considerations
paragraphs: •   Use role="list" on the container and role="listitem" on each item; nested groups use role="group".
•   Expose the nesting level with aria-level, and aria-expanded on parents that have children.
•   When text is truncated, provide a tooltip with the full text.
•   Dragging must have a non-drag alternative (gesture alternatives, WCAG rules §7).

sections.heading: Keyboard interactions
paragraphs: Move between items at the same level
Enter, Space and Escape are listed in the skill without defined actions.

sections.heading: Design recommendations
paragraphs: Automated contrast check — WCAG 2.x relative luminance (sRGB), text against the rendered row background, for every theme combination (project-a/b × light/dark). Minimum 4.5:1; 3:1 for disabled text (house rule TKN-005). Size=Md.
